name: rackverb
author: hundekraft
description: rackverb is a rack of four effects units from the late 80s, with 316 programs between them: big halls, gated drum rooms and reverse reverbs, then flangers, slapback echoes and wide choruses. VERB I has 63 programs: reverbs, gated rooms and reverse rooms. VERB II has 100, from 00 to 99: reverbs, gates, reverses, flangers, choruses, delays and a few odd ones. Program 00 is a bypass. FEX has 63 echoes, multi-tap delays, slapbacks and stereo wideners.
credits: Written from Eric Brombaugh's and thement's published Midiverb research; no Alesis ROM data
